name: lp-prose
description: One section of a long-form page (legal pages, guides, webinar notes): an optional anchored heading over rich text (paragraphs, lists, tables, quotes, images, links) set in the kit's reading type on a centred 760px column. Stack one per heading so the page-toc panel can jump between them. lead: the opening paragraph(s) in larger type; panel: the section on a soft rounded panel (contact boxes, summaries).

anchor.description: id of the section heading, for page-toc and #links (letters, digits, hyphens, underscores).

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the heading.

title.description: Section heading. Empty renders the text alone.

html.description: The section text as HTML. Kept: p, h3-h6, ul, ol, li, a (href, title), strong, b, em, i, u, br, sup, sub, small, mark, code, blockquote, hr, figure, figcaption, img (src, alt, width, height), table, caption, thead, tbody, tfoot, tr, th, td (colspan, rowspan, scope); an id on h3-h6. Everything else (classes, styles, scripts, iframes) is removed; links off the site open in a new tab.

variant.description: body: the reading type. lead: larger opening text. panel: on a soft rounded panel.

space.description: Vertical space: normal between sections; start adds room above (first section after a full-width band); end adds room below (the last section before the footer).
